title: FieldGuard Cloud Analysis
description: Returned by the cloud analyst (ONLY_IN_CLOUD). The first six fields are identical to the on-device classifier schema v1.0, so one record shape works for both. The extra fields (rationale, recommendations, ...) exist only on the cloud result. The risk score, risk level and the on-device/cloud badge are computed by the app, never by the model.

suggestedAction.description: One-line version of the most important recommendation.

rationale.description: Short explanation of why this likelihood and severity were suggested.

requiresImmediateAction.description: Optional suggestion to stop work or isolate the area now. Never a statement that anything is safe.

uncertaintyNotes.description: Anything the model could not determine from the report. Shown to the inspector.
